song_craft: Voice: closing couplets. Arc: longing (v19) -> festival (v20) -> SEAL: yielding to the better poet, water in a potsherd (v21). The work ends by naming its own vessel. L4 = L3 throughout.

l4.sanskrit_cite: utkaṇṭhayanti pathikāṇ jaladāḥ svanantaḥ śoko vivardhati ca tadvinatāsv anantaḥ

verses.craft: SthAyin same work-voice; color: longing-awakened. End-weight endless (ananta uncut). L3 sings; L4 recognizes.
verses.rejected: (a) explaining endless -> killed: endless is the close. (b) thunder->storm kept: thunder thunders.

lines: They honor the love-festival with beloveds —
l4.sanskrit_cite: ratyutsavaṃ priyatamaiḥ saha mānayanti meghāgamaṃ priyasakhi śvasamānayanti

verses.craft: Color: communal joy (rasa communal per argmap). Vocative kept; festival kept public.
verses.rejected: (a) modernizing festival -> killed: utsava is ancient-public. (b) they-bring->announce kept: bring brings.

lines: May I be conquered — by which other poet, with yamakas —
to him I pour water in a potsherd.
l4.sanskrit_cite: jīyeya yena kavinā yamakaiḥ pareṇa tasmai vaheyam udakaṃ ghaṭakarpareṇa

verses.craft: SEAL of the work: yielding; potsherd names itself (literal kept, metaphor in C1). Speaker/yamaka opens held per BOUNDARY.
verses.rejected: (a) resolving speaker -> killed held-open. (b) naming yamaka words -> killed unidentified. (c) closing with triumph -> killed: yielding is the close.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ['Speaker self vs other; which words yamaka (both live).']) / C1 / L3 frozen
